transcript_full: And finally, on the climate, I wrote the state's strongest climate ordinance, and I got it passed to the city of Miami. One, we declared a climate emergency in the city, very few cities have done that. Two, we set a goal of climate neutral by 2050. And three, I passed an ordinance that would force a thousand towers in the city of Miami to comply by measuring their efficiencies for water electricity every year and investing in improvements every five years.
